verdict.rationale: Godot has no first-party natural-language or agentic control layer: there is no official MCP server, no llms.txt, and its automation surface (CLI, EditorScript, GDScript plugins) is purely programmatic, not NL-driven. However, community-built MCP servers (Coding-Solo/godot-mcp, hi-godot/godot-ai) let AI agents drive the editor via natural language, showing the capability is achievable but only through unofficial third-party tooling. missing for 10: an official/first-party MCP server or NL command interface, vendor documentation of AI-agent control, and independent hands-on verification that the community MCP servers work reliably.
